## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**  
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 5/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: mixed sector returns this week (Energy out, Tech/Industrials weak) and Broad leadership (Top 5 across 4 sectors), supporting a neutral read rather than a clear risk-on or risk-off.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**  
Energy leads: VLO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +22.59%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND, CVX (1W: +5.78% | 1M: +14.35%) ABOVE TREND. Healthcare steady: NVS (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +2.82% | 1M: +11.62%) ABOVE TREND.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**  
Industrials lag: HON (1W: -5.79% | 1M: -16.07%) BELOW TREND, MMM (1W: -5.88% | 1M: -7.16%) BELOW TREND, CAT (1W: -2.06% | 1M: -8.14%) BELOW TREND. Technology weak: AMAT (1W: -9.63% | 1M: -18.32%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -8.14% | 1M: -4.80%) BELOW TREND, PANW (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -8.47%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**  
Top 5: DE (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +13.47%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +22.59%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND, TMUS (1W: +6.39% | 1M: +9.02%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Broad (4 sectors in Top 5); style leaning toward Value/Cyclicals given heavy Energy/Industrial representation.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**  
Bottom 5: PANW (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -8.47%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -9.63% | 1M: -18.32%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -8.14% | 1M: -4.80%) BELOW TREND, TTWO (1W: -8.10% | 1M: -8.85%) BELOW TREND, PYPL (1W: -7.56% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in high-multiple Tech and select Industrials/FinTech names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**  
Highest 1W movers: DE (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +13.47%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +22.59%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND, MPC (1W: +6.65% | 1M: +30.57%) ABOVE TREND, TSLA (1W: +6.08% | 1M: +17.05%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: several large caps (GOOGL (1W: +0.54% | 1M: -5.50%) RECOVERY, AMZN (1W: +1.03% | 1M: -5.04%) RECOVERY, WMT (1W: +5.64% | 1M: -3.26%) RECOVERY) show 1W/1M splits — watch for trend breaks; treat moves as tactical rather than structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**  
Mixed-to-weak with clear dispersion: AAPL (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND, MSFT (1W: +1.00% | 1M: +4.85%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +4.21%) ABOVE TREND, while AMAT (1W: -9.63% | 1M: -18.32%) BELOW TREND and LRCX (1W: -8.14% | 1M: -4.80%) BELOW TREND lag — sector tone is mixed and breadth is weak this week.

**8. Financials Outlook?**  
Financials are mixed but resilient: JPM (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND, V (1W: -0.24% | 1M: +2.96%) CORRECTION, MA (1W: -1.02% | 1M: +2.67%) CORRECTION; PYPL (1W: -7.56% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND creates idiosyncratic risk — overall sector showing internal rotation.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**  
Healthcare constructive on balance: JNJ (1W: +4.76% | 1M: +8.62%) ABOVE TREND, PFE (1W: +2.82% | 1M: +11.62%) ABOVE TREND, NVS (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND, while LLY (1W: -1.40% | 1M: -0.73%) BELOW TREND is an outlier; sector breadth this week supports defensiveness pockets but not a broad flight to safety.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**  
Favor Energy and select Financials and cyclicals given recent outperformance (VLO, MPC, DE, JPM) and Broad leadership; reduce exposure to weak, high-multiple Tech names showing large 1W downside (AMAT, LRCX, PANW). Style: mixed / lean Value/Cyclical while monitoring large-cap Tech RECOVERY signals for confirmation.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: DE (1W: +11.52% | 1M: +13.47%) ABOVE TREND, VLO (1W: +6.95% | 1M: +22.59%) ABOVE TREND, META (1W: +6.93% | 1M: +3.72%) ABOVE TREND.  
BEARISH: PANW (1W: -13.30% | 1M: -8.47%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -9.63% | 1M: -18.32%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -8.14% | 1M: -4.80%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**  
BULLISH: Energy (1W: +4.22% | 1M: +16.04%) showing clear leadership and momentum.  
BEARISH: Technology (1W: -1.40% | 1M: +2.14%) and Industrials (1W: -2.58% | 1M: -4.67%) where weakness is concentrated and dispersion is rising.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**  
Monitor NVDA (1W: +0.21% | 1M: +4.21%) ABOVE TREND for pickup above prior highs as confirmation of Tech broadening; watch AAPL (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND holding recent consolidation as support for market internals; watch JPM (1W: +2.21% | 1M: +0.78%) ABOVE TREND for continuation above short-term resistance to confirm Financials carry.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**  
NVS (+50): Phase III Remibrutinib win headline; price NVS (1W: +5.46% | 1M: +5.60%) ABOVE TREND — sentiment confirmed.  
PYPL (+80): Takeover chatter; price PYPL (1W: -7.56% | 1M: -1.92%) BELOW TREND — sentiment diverging from price, signals distribution or takeover premium priced into a weak base.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**  
AAPL (-40): Foldable iPhone supply concerns; price AAPL (1W: +4.33% | 1M: +5.62%) ABOVE TREND — negative headlines vs rising price = divergence, watch for distribution.  
AMGN (-70): UK withdrawal headline; price (not in top detailed view) should be monitored for confirmation or divergence given conflicting Amgen headlines this week.

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear Growth vs Value dominance.  
Energy and select cyclicals are showing relative strength (DE ABOVE TREND, VLO ABOVE TREND, MPC ABOVE TREND).  
Key risk: MAJOR divergence across large caps (multiple RECOVERY cases and headline-driven divergences like PYPL and AAPL) — watch for trend confirmation before enlarging exposures.
